title: The Paper Typewriter
author: Astrid Lockridge
blurb: Ivo Ashgrove, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the century turns.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
